panels.description: Bar trend of glm53-flash requests split by content: 'with image' = request contains image_url parts in proxy_server_request.messages; 'text only' = no images. Scope: selected time range + key group, glm53-flash only. Bucket: $__interval.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(s."startTime", $__interval),
  CASE WHEN ic.imgs > 0 THEN 'with image' ELSE 'text only' END AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS requests
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) AS imgs
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.proxy_server_request->'messages')='array'
         THEN s.proxy_server_request->'messages' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m->'content')='array' THEN m->'content' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) c
  WHERE c->>'type'='image_url'
) ic
WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
  AND s.api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})
  AND s.model_group = 'glm53-flash'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Image Requests (glm53-flash)

panels.description: All glm53-flash requests containing image_url parts in the request. image_count = number of image parts parsed from messages. Image-specific token counts are not reported upstream (prompt_tokens_details.image_tokens is null), so input/output tokens are the request totals.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s."startTime" AS time,
  s.request_id,
  s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' AS key_alias,
  s.model_group,
  s.status,
  s.prompt_tokens AS input_tokens,
  s.completion_tokens AS output_tokens,
  ic.imgs AS image_count,
  LEFT(COALESCE(s.metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','-'),60) AS error
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) AS imgs
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.proxy_server_request->'messages')='array'
         THEN s.proxy_server_request->'messages' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m->'content')='array' THEN m->'content' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) c
  WHERE c->>'type'='image_url'
) ic
WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
  AND s.api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})
  AND s.model_group = 'glm53-flash'
  AND ic.imgs > 0
ORDER BY s."startTime" DESC
LIMIT 500
